MR Safety
The Cobalt Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Cobalt Neuromodulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Cobalt Neuromodulation System
Device Configuration MRI mode ON
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T and 3.0T
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 12 T/m
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: B1+rms must not exceed 1.7 µT
Scan Duration at 3T: Limit total active scanning to 20 min. A cooling period of 15 minutes is required between scans.
Scan Regions Head Only
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 25 mm from the device.
